URBAN TANDOOR & GRILL

RESTAURANT PROFILE  |  AI RESTAURANT ASSISTANT DEMO

Great Food, Every Hour, Every Day.

Urban Tandoor & Grill is a fictional, family-oriented multi-cuisine restaurant in Karachi, Pakistan. It serves traditional Pakistani food, BBQ, fast food, pizza, Chinese and continental dishes, breakfast, desserts and beverages. Both branches operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with separate kitchens, ingredient inventories, dining spaces and order queues.

Guests can dine in, order takeaway at the counter, request home delivery, or submit a pre-order for a scheduled pickup or delivery time. The restaurant also accepts orders via Foodpanda, subject to available platform integration. Its AI voice and chat assistant supports menu discovery, ordering, order tracking, table reservations, recommendations, complaints and feedback.

PECHS seating configuration:  8 four-person tables, 6 two-person tables and 4 seven-person tables. Family seating, takeaway counter, kitchen, inventory and own-delivery dispatch.

Gulshan seating configuration:  8 two-person tables, 10 four-person tables and 6 group tables (four with 9 seats, two with 10). Family/group seating, takeaway counter, kitchen, inventory and dispatch.

Both addresses are location placeholders for synthetic test data; building numbers and verified delivery zones have not been defined.

Menu item prices, variants, preparation times, allergens and branch-level availability will be defined in the menu master dataset. Breakfast availability may follow scheduled service hours despite 24/7 branch operations.

Dine-in and OTC:  Customers place orders with restaurant staff or through the assistant; kitchen tickets enter the branch queue. Counter payments and takeaway collection are supported.

Direct delivery:  The AI assistant collects the customer address, validates branch delivery coverage, checks menu and ingredient availability, confirms payment terms, and creates an order for in-house delivery.

Foodpanda:  Third-party orders enter the same operational order model through an approved integration or supported staff workflow; platform-managed delivery and settlement rules remain distinct.

Pre-orders (scheduled orders):  Customers may order in advance for a specified future pickup or delivery date and time, selecting the branch and available items. The assistant confirms the requested schedule, items, quantity, contact details and fulfillment method. Backend checks include lead time, branch capacity, stock policy and delivery coverage. Pre-orders enter a scheduled queue and are released to the kitchen at the appropriate preparation time; acceptance is subject to availability and restaurant confirmation. Inventory reservation timing and changes/cancellation cutoffs are configurable.

Customers can reserve tables at either branch by party size, date and time. The system checks table availability and capacity to prevent double bookings, records reservation status and supports modifications or cancellations under configured policies. Kitchen queue management tracks orders from accepted through preparing, ready, dispatched/served and completed, while keeping pre-orders separate until their release time.

Supported flows include Cash on Delivery, cash on-counter, and eligible bank-card transactions where payment facilities exist. The demo business rule specifies a 10% bank discount; eligibility, caps, bank list, discount stacking and whether it applies to delivery or pre-orders must be configured before production use. The assistant can suggest combo deals, add-ons and relevant discounts without applying unverified offers.

Each branch tracks its own ingredient stock and recipe consumption. Before an order is accepted, the backend verifies available-to-promise inventory against recipe requirements and existing reservations. If an item is unavailable, the assistant suggests genuinely available alternatives in the same category, taking customer preferences and dietary constraints into account. Completed or cancelled orders reconcile stock reservations according to the inventory policy.

The voice/chat assistant supports menu questions, ingredient inquiries, order status, reservation changes, delivery issues, complaints and feedback. Cases are logged, categorized and escalated to staff when needed. Restaurant master data is maintained in a validated Excel workbook and synchronized to the operational database; live orders, payment states, queues and inventory transactions remain database-managed.

DEMO DATA NOTICE  |  This document describes a fictional restaurant. Name, locations, capacities and menu examples are synthetic and must not be represented as verified business facts.
